SUBGROUPS

If you are a coach or manager, you can easily plan events and invite players or teammates directly from your mobile.

ATTENDANCE
You will confirm your participation in the event within a few seconds. With mobile attendance, team leaders will know in time who they can count on and who is skipping this time and why. You can also assign non-team members to events. If the event is full, the applicant can join the queue and will be informed if the place becomes available. You can easily find out who you can rely on based on the statistics.

TEAM CHAT AND CHAT FOR EVENTS

You can customize a number of features including: choosing the name, all the statistics, and also use the front camera to get your face on the card! 

Features
- 213 Nations
- Full Customization of the card
- More than twenty cards to chose from
- Add your personal photo using your front camera or camera roll*
- Share it on Facebook, Twitter, Flickr, Mail and much more!

*Camera and camera roll permissions are required to add your own pictures to the cards.

Are you a big football fan? Do you want to know and collect all the player cards? Then this app is perfect for you.

Unlimited card packs give you access to all player information. Card packs of different colors correspond to players of different levels.

You can easily sort players by country, club, league, etc.

You can even transfer duplicate players, so you have a certain probability of getting very good players.

Come on, collect enough good players, and realize your dream of collecting the strongest team as soon as possible. Best wishes to all football fans!

Formulify brings Formula 1 Widgets to Your Home Screen and Lock Screen.

For beginning, app brings F1 Calendar with all session times and even more, a countdown to upcoming Race Start. Next it gives You the opportunity to track the current Standings - both Constructors Championship and Drivers championship. And all this with different Widgets variations. Apart from this, You can track Your favourite teams with 'WCC Grid Widget', which can be customised to show Constructor standings of Your preferred teams. Similarly, possibility to track progress of Your favourite drivers with Custom 'F1 Driver Standings' Widget is available. One more thing - rewind of most legendary F1 radio messages is present with 'Team Radio Message of the Day' Widget, which as its title hints, refreshes daily with radio message of the day.

Widgets are available as both Home-Screen & Lock-Screen and are updated on regular basis with aim to bring latest result as soon as possible for entire 2023 F1 season.
